query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!"
        FROM customers c
        WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR c.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR c.phone ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
          AND ($2::text IS NULL
               OR ($2 = 'belanja' AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM transactions t
                   WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND t.status = 'completed'))
               OR c.source = $2)
